snippet.title: Bases Loaded '96: Double Header (1995) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Bases Loaded '96: Double Header is a 1995 sports video game released for the Sega Saturn and the Sony PlayStation. This game was the eighth and final game in the Bases Loaded series and the only one developed internally by Jaleco, after Tose had developed the previous seven installments.

Initial release date: 1995
Mode: Multiplayer video game
Developer: Jaleco
Publisher: Jaleco
Platforms: Playstation, Sega Saturn
Genres: Sports Video Game, Simulation Game
